app.title: Event Timeline PoC
header.syntheticNotice: All data shown here is fictional and synthetic (not related to any real company, service, or person).
top.intro: A prototype that lines up events from different sources—application logs, business transactions, monitoring, and audit logs—on a single timeline to see what happened, and in what order.
top.howTo: Pick a scenario and track down the cause of an incident or a customer inquiry from scattered events. You can check your answer at the end.

timeline.noEvents: No events match the current filters.
histogram.label: Event counts over time (colored by source)
histogram.hint: Drag across the chart to filter by that time range.

hints.title: Tips
hints.selectEvent: Select an event to see its original data and related IDs.
hints.filterById: Use "Filter by this ID" in the details to line up only the events for the same order, user, or trace across all sources.
